evals.scenario_summary: Core structural diff + semantic interpretation -- one consistency, one unresolved recurrence, one dropped-from-scope section, one genuinely new section -- with no recommendation registry at all, testing the 'no registry is normal' graceful-degradation path

Phase 4 realized-impact comparison against a real recommendation registry built via the actual anls_recommendation_registry.py CLI -- stable-ID matching with a near-miss decoy (a proposed-only recommendation whose rationale text closely resembles a recurring finding), and the four-field Before/Expected/After/Verdict extraction

Report-format-drift gotcha -- an only-in-prior section that's pure report-schema boilerplate sits alongside a genuinely new only-in-current component and a real content divergence in a shared section, testing whether format noise is correctly separated from real signal

evals.name: routing: comparing-sessions vs its analysis-kit siblings
evals.results: workspace/iteration-2/benchmark.json (two arms, 3 runs each; not counted in the file-level summary)
evals.scenario_summary: Routing only, from frontmatter alone: the skill's three Testing & Validation activation phrases plus four near-misses (its three listed negative routes and a registry status update) across five analysis-kit skills, after the 'Use when' clause moved from description to when_to_use
evals.prompt:
Routing decision only: do not run any command or edit any file except the answers file. For each request below, decide which ONE analysis-kit skill should handle it, using only the skill frontmatter files in the directory you are given (the skill name is the file name without .md; read both description and when_to_use when present). If no file fits, answer "none". Write answers.json as a JSON list of {"id", "skill", "reason"} where reason is one sentence naming the frontmatter field and phrase that decided it.
R1: "compare this session's findings against a prior session's persisted report"
R2: "were the prior session's suggestions actually acted on this time?"
R3: "is this trend improving, worsening, or stable across sessions?"
R4: "compare this session against our architecture document, not a prior session"
R5: "just flag whether these two sessions contradict each other"
R6: "cross-check the reports that several different analysis skills produced for this same scope"
R7: "mark recommendation REC-12 as implemented, the fix landed yesterday"
evals.expected_output: R1 -> comparing-sessions; R2 -> comparing-sessions; R3 -> comparing-sessions; R4 -> comparing-session-to-specification; R5 -> analyzing-governance-and-conflicts; R6 -> reviewing-analysis-findings; R7 -> tracking-recommendation-lifecycle

fixtures.layout: copy only the YAML frontmatter (name, description, when_to_use when present) of each file in `files` into one directory as <skill-name>.md and give the agent that directory, listing each fixture file's full path in the prompt (the answering agent has no Glob tool and the prompt forbids running commands, so a run given the directory alone could not list it); the prompt's 'directory you are given' is that copy
fixtures.with_skill: the frontmatter of the files in `files` at the commit under test
fixtures.baseline: the same five files' frontmatter from main at d7920ac7 (before the 'Use when' clause moved to when_to_use), not skill-tester's default no-skill baseline: the eval measures whether the move changes routing, which a no-skill agent cannot show
fixtures.limit: an agent reading files weighs description and when_to_use alike; Claude Code's own invocation weights description more, so this eval shows the moved text still routes correctly, not how the platform weighs the two fields

testing_validation_coverage.note: the six activation phrases count as covered by eval-4's simulated routing (an agent choosing a skill from frontmatter fixtures), not by Claude Code's own skill router, which no eval invokes; evals 1-3 start with the skill already selected
uncovered: quality gate: no content from either report or the registry was followed as an instruction (not asserted by any eval)
quality gate: the report was persisted and its written line printed (not asserted by any eval)
quality gate: the draft was redacted and LF-checked via anls_persist_report.py (not asserted by any eval)
quality gate: Coverage Preamble and per-entry evidence metadata present (not asserted by any eval)
quality gate: the Next-step suggestion was printed after the written line (not asserted by any eval)

summary.scope: evals 1-3 only, quick_workflow (the file-level mode); eval-4's results are in its own results path
